subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed workspace skill diagnostics be considered complete with a focused `openclaw skills lint` surface, or must normal `skills list`, `skills check`, `skills.status`, and Web skill views also show skipped `SKILL.md` candidates before this issue closes?
rationale: Current main has the reported silent-drop behavior, and the open PR is a plausible fix path, but the issue text explicitly asks for normal CLI and Web visibility while the live PR review still flags lint-only scope as a product decision.

options.title: Require normal-surface diagnostics
options.body: Treat the issue as complete only when skipped malformed candidates are visible through the ordinary CLI/status/Web paths or a clearly linked follow-up owns those surfaces.

options.title: Accept lint-first scope
options.body: Land a corrected `skills lint` command as the first supported validation surface and keep broader list/status/Web warnings as a separate product follow-up.

options.title: Defer custom skill diagnostics
options.body: Leave the behavior as a documented authoring constraint for now and close or deprioritize the candidate PR as outside current product scope.

recommendation.title: Require normal-surface diagnostics
recommendation.body: Treat the issue as complete only when skipped malformed candidates are visible through the ordinary CLI/status/Web paths or a clearly linked follow-up owns those surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current history across the central loader, parser, CLI, and docs surfaces where the product boundary must be set.
